shared_elements: inscribed/incised script signs on a vertical stone face
text arranged in columns/rows on a flat panel
justification: Both surfaces bear inscribed writing on an upright stone face, arranged in ordered columns, which is the only real correspondence. A shows dense, pictorial glyph blocks with faces, hands and animal heads in a two-column grid, while B shows faint, purely linear alphabetic-looking lines on a cliff face with no figural imagery at all.
